concepts.proposed_markdown: For a configured POS signature check, the Terminal API transaction is already authorized when the signature screen appears; the terminal approves that screen even if the shopper cancels it. The merchant POS can use `CapturedSignature` from `PaymentResponse` for staff review; a declined check then requires refund, or cancellation of the authorization if a suitable capture delay was arranged. This website guide also has conflicting summary/detail wording about whether every contactless transaction above the CVM limit requires online PIN: its detailed NFC passage makes online PIN conditional on the card selecting PIN. [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-cardholder-verification-methods]]
warnings: Do not treat the source's broad above-limit online-PIN sentence as a universal rule; raw line 211 conditions online PIN on the card indicating PIN rather than signature.
